comparison.objective: Fill and remove a blood tube while a needle remains stationary in a training arm; candidate transfers a bearing block.
comparison.physical_skill: Record stabilizes a needle holder while pushing a tube onto a back needle, filling it and pulling it off. Candidate aligns a jig and slides an uncaged block across a support boundary.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires stopper piercing, adequate fill, tube removal and tray placement, invalidating needle movement or holder release. Candidate requires complete transfer and retention of all balls without a support gap or damage.
comparison.reason: Although both require one hand to stabilize while the other translates a component, tube coupling is not continuous loose-element containment.
